name: prompt-convert-trigger-plugin
description: Use proactively when a request would benefit from structured prompt engineering -- involves complexity, vagueness, multi-step work, or spans multiple concerns -- converting it into a COSTAR or CRISPE prompt before executing; don't wait for an explicit ask. 支持中文触发信号，如多目标表达（修复X同时让Y也能工作）、不确定表达（我不确定怎么、可能是）、模糊动词（改进、优化）等同类情况。
